summary: Ulta Beauty filed a Form 8-K reporting the appointment of Brieane L. Olson as an independent director, effective August 31, 2026, filling the seat vacated by Kelly E. Garcia. Olson is CEO of PacSun and brings specialty retail experience. The board determined her independence under Nasdaq and SEC rules, and she will receive standard board compensation. No unusual departure or conflict was noted. This is a routine board change, not a special situation; no deal terms or strategic actions were disclosed. The filing is classified as None, as it does not involve a merger, tender, activist, or other major corporate event.
